prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: My brother, who lives in Tainan, is a doctor.
My brother, that lives in Tainan, is a doctor.
My brother which lives in Tainan is a doctor.
answer: My brother, who lives in Tainan, is a doctor.

wrong.My brother, that lives in Tainan, is a d: 非限定關係子句前有逗號，不能用 that，要用 who 或 which。
wrong.My brother which lives in Tainan is a do: which 不能指人，my brother 是人，要用 who。

why: 補充說明用的非限定子句，兩側用逗號隔開，並用 who。
tip: 補充說明的子句要有逗號，且不用 that。
say: My brother, who lives in Tainan, is a doctor.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Students who cheat will fail the test.
options: 只有作弊的學生會不及格
所有學生都作弊，所以都不及格
學生不及格都是因為作弊
answer: 只有作弊的學生會不及格

wrong.所有學生都作弊，所以都不及格: who cheat 是限定子句，用來指出「作弊的那一群」學生，並不表示全部學生都作弊。
wrong.學生不及格都是因為作弊: 句子只說作弊的人會不及格，沒有說所有不及格的原因都是作弊。

why: 沒有逗號的 who cheat 用來限定是哪些學生，所以只指作弊的人。
tip: 沒有逗號的子句是在限定指的是誰。
say: Students who cheat will fail the test.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: The book _____ I borrowed from the library is about volcanoes.
options: that
who
what

wrong.who: who 用來指人，book 是物品，不能用 who。
wrong.what: what 本身已含先行詞的意思，不能放在名詞 book 後面當關係代名詞。

why: 先行詞 book 是物，限定子句可以用 that 或 which。
tip: 限定子句中，物用 that，人用 who。
say: The book that I borrowed from the library is about volcanoes.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Jade Mountain, _____ is the highest peak in Taiwan, attracts many hikers.
options: which
that
what

wrong.that: 逗號後面的非限定子句不能用 that，要用 which。
wrong.what: what 不能接在先行詞 Jade Mountain 後面當關係代名詞。

why: 逗號後補充說明的子句，指物時用 which。
tip: 逗號後指物用 which，不用 that。
say: Jade Mountain, which is the highest peak in Taiwan, attracts many hikers.

prompt: 你想介紹你的媽媽，順便說她在醫院工作。哪一句最自然？
options: My mother, who works at a hospital, is very kind.
My mother, which works at a hospital, is very kind.
My mother, that works at a hospital, is very kind.
answer: My mother, who works at a hospital, is very kind.

wrong.My mother, which works at a hospital, is: mother 是人，要用 who，which 只用來指事物。
wrong.My mother, that works at a hospital, is: 逗號後的非限定子句不能用 that。

why: 媽媽只有一位，補充說明用逗號加 who 最自然。
tip: 指人的補充說明用「逗號＋who」。
say: My mother, who works at a hospital, is very kind.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: That is the old house _____ my grandfather was born.
options: where
which
who

wrong.which: which 在子句中要當主詞或受詞，但 my grandfather was born 已經完整，缺的是地點，所以要用 where。
wrong.who: who 指人，house 是地方，不能用 who。

why: 先行詞是地點，關係子句缺地方副詞，用 where。
tip: 先行詞是地方且子句完整，用 where。
say: That is the old house where my grandfather was born.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: I like the coat that you bought yesterday.
I like the coat who you bought yesterday.
I like the coat what you bought yesterday.
answer: I like the coat that you bought yesterday.

wrong.I like the coat what you bought yesterda: what 不能當關係代名詞接在名詞 coat 後面，要用 that 或 which。
wrong.I like the coat who you bought yesterday: who 只能指人，coat 是外套，要用 that 或 which。

why: that you bought yesterday 限定是哪件外套，不加逗號。
tip: that 子句不加逗號，what 不接名詞。
say: I like the coat that you bought yesterday.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: Her new phone, which she bought online, stopped working.
options: 她的新手機壞了，順帶一提那是她網購的
她有好幾支手機，壞掉的是網購的那支
她的手機是她在網路上賣掉的
answer: 她的新手機壞了，順帶一提那是她網購的

wrong.她有好幾支手機，壞掉的是網購的那支: 有逗號的子句只是補充說明，不是用來在好幾支手機中挑出一支。
wrong.她的手機是她在網路上賣掉的: bought online 是「在網路上買」，不是賣掉。

why: 逗號中的 which she bought online 只是附加資訊。
tip: 逗號夾住的內容只是補充資訊。
say: Her new phone, which she bought online, stopped working.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Mr. Lin, _____ taught me English last year, is moving to Japan.
options: who
whom
whose

wrong.whom: whom 是受詞，但子句中 taught 缺主詞，所以要用主詞形 who。
wrong.whose: whose 表示「…的」，後面要接名詞，這裡 taught 前面缺的是主詞。

why: 關係子句缺主詞，指人，用 who。
tip: 關係詞當主詞，指人就用 who。
say: Mr. Lin, who taught me English last year, is moving to Japan.

prompt: 你想說「王老師教過我們國文，她明年要退休」。哪一句正確？
options: Ms. Wang, who taught us Chinese, will retire next year.
Ms. Wang, which taught us Chinese, will retire next year.
Ms. Wang, whom taught us Chinese, will retire next year.
answer: Ms. Wang, who taught us Chinese, will retire next year.

wrong.Ms. Wang, which taught us Chinese, will: which 不能指人，Ms. Wang 是人，要用 who。
wrong.Ms. Wang, whom taught us Chinese, will r: whom 是受詞形，但 taught 前面缺主詞，應該用 who。

why: 人名後面補充說明，用逗號加主詞形 who。
tip: 人名後的補充說明用逗號加 who。
say: Ms. Wang, who taught us Chinese, will retire next year.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The restaurant where we had lunch was crowded.
The restaurant which we had lunch was crowded.
The restaurant where we had lunch there was crowded.
answer: The restaurant where we had lunch was crowded.

wrong.The restaurant which we had lunch was cr: which 在子句中要當受詞，但 had lunch 已經完整，少了介系詞 at，要用 where 或 at which。
wrong.The restaurant where we had lunch there: where 已經代表「在那裡」，再加 there 就重複了。

why: where 同時是連接詞和地點副詞，不需要再加 there。
tip: where 已含「在那裡」，不要再加 there。
say: The restaurant where we had lunch was crowded.

prompt: 選出最適合填入空格的字。
text: Tom has two sisters, _____ are both teachers.
options: who
that
whom

wrong.that: 句子有逗號，是補充說明，不能用 that。
wrong.whom: 子句缺的是主詞（are 的主詞），不能用受詞形 whom。

why: 逗號後補充說明，指人且當主詞，用 who。
tip: 逗號後的人當主詞，用 who。
say: Tom has two sisters, who are both teachers.

prompt: 這個句子的意思是什麼？
text: The students, who were tired, left early.
options: 所有學生都累了，而且提早離開
只有累的學生提早離開
學生因為提早離開才覺得累
answer: 所有學生都累了，而且提早離開

wrong.只有累的學生提早離開: 有逗號的 who were tired 只是補充說明，並沒有把學生分成累的和不累的兩群。
wrong.學生因為提早離開才覺得累: 句子沒有說離開造成疲累，累是補充的狀態，不是結果。

why: 非限定子句是附加說明，所以指全體學生。
tip: 有逗號時，指的是全體而不是一部分。
say: The students, who were tired, left early.
